pages.title: Okapi
pages.text: The okapi ($(o)Okapia johnstoni$()) is a giraffid native to the dense rainforests of the Democratic Republic of the Congo in central Africa.$(br2)Although its striped legs resemble a zebra's, it is the closest living relative of the giraffe, and males bear short, skin-covered ossicones.$(br2)Shy and solitary, the okapi browses on leaves and buds with its long tongue, and it was unknown to Western science until the early 20th century.
